column1: # Palaka-HK golden word list: roman <TAB> expected Telugu.
# Every pair is tested in both directions: toTelugu(roman) = telugu and toRoman(telugu) = roman.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. \uXXXX escapes are allowed (used for ZWNJ).
# Reviewed by eye by a native reader; after that this file guards every change.
# --- Every consonant with the inherent vowel
# --- Guninta of ka: every vowel sign
# --- Less common letters in real words
# --- ZWNJ: the pollu stays visible instead of forming a conjunct
# --- Break key: splits keys that would otherwise merge
